sources.snippet: MOSS-TTS-Nano is an open-source multilingual tiny speech generation model from MOSI.AI and the OpenMOSS team. With only 0.1B parameters, it is designed for realtime speech generation, can run directly on CPU without a GPU, and keeps the deployment stack simple enough for local demos, web serving, and lightweight product integration.

sources.title: MOSS-TTS-Nano | Multilingual Speech Generation - openmoss.ai
sources.snippet: MOSS-TTS-Nano is a deployment-first TTS model designed for realtime speech generation, voice cloning, and lightweight integration. Built on an Audio Tokenizer + LLM autoregressive pipeline, it stays compact enough for practical CPU use while covering Chinese, English, and a broad multilingual set.
